title: Unemployment Insurance Trust Fund Forecast, June 2026

passages.question: Did the wage base change for 2026, and is a solvency tax added this year?
passages.excerpt: State law increased the taxable wage base from $72,800 to $78,200 in 2026. ... The flat social tax rate is 0.60% for 2026 and will be 0.61% in 2027. ... An employer's social tax rate starts with the flat social tax rate, with a cap of 1.22%. Then we graduate it by rate class. ... For 2028 the solvency tax rate is 0.20%. all other years were 0%.
